actions.action: Slide plant out of pot and check roots
Trim rotten roots with clean scissors if present
Check inner pot drainage holes and empty standing water from outer pot
Repot in gritty cactus mix with perlite in a draining pot if needed
Check soil with finger or skewer and water only when top 4-5 cm is dry
Move plant to south-facing window with 6+ hours direct sun
Cut back leggy stems once roots are healthy
Wear gloves when handling or pruning
Take stem tip cuttings as backup if roots mostly rotten

reason: The answer explicitly rejects dehydration in favour of overwatering, and its advice to water less and repot would worsen a thirsty plant and delay the needed watering.
